name: auditorium
portrait_prompt: Photograph of {desc}, seated in a padded auditorium seat, facing the camera directly with the head upright and level, framed from well above the top of the head down to the knees with clear space above the hair, hands resting in the lap, attentive neutral expression, eyes looking straight into the lens. Plain medium-grey seamless studio backdrop. Soft warm front light like stage lighting. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/4, natural skin texture with pores, true-to-life colour, candid documentary photo. No text, no logos.
negative_prompt: camera movement, zoom, pan, cut, scene change, morphing face, face changing, extra fingers, distorted hands, blurry, text, subtitles, cartoon, 3d render, video game

states.listen: The person sits still in the seat and listens attentively to a speaker in front of them, breathing naturally, blinking, with small natural head movements. They end in the same pose they started in. Locked-off camera.
states.engaged: The person leans forward slightly with interest, nods twice in agreement with a small smile, then settles back into the same pose. Locked-off camera.
states.bored: The person looks bored, slumps a little, glances away to the side, sighs and shifts in the seat, then returns to the starting pose. Locked-off camera.
states.phone: The person picks up a phone from their lap, looks down and scrolls on it with their thumb, then puts it back in their lap and returns to the starting pose. Locked-off camera.
states.confused: The person frowns slightly, tilts their head and looks puzzled, then returns to the starting pose. Locked-off camera.
states.clap: The person smiles and claps their hands warmly for a few seconds, then rests their hands back in their lap. Locked-off camera.
